verdict: Yes, if you can explain the science simply. Cos IQ pitched an ethical, science-led cosmetic brand on Shark Tank India Season 1 and got a deal. Buyers now read ingredient labels and look for active ingredients like niacinamide and retinol, but the market is crowded with similar brands.
angle: Science-led skincare built around specific ingredients and concerns has grown fast in India. Dermatologists and skincare creators influence buyers. Honest claims, lab-tested products and clear routines build trust.
